name: intraday-spy-qqq-v1
description: Gao, Han, Li & Zhou (2018) 'Market Intraday Momentum': the return from the previous close to 10:00 ET (and/or the penultimate half hour 15:00-15:30 ET) predicts the last half hour (15:30-16:00 ET) return on SPY/QQQ. Entry ~15:30 ET, exit at the close (last RTH bar), long and short, no overnight position.
